name: Instance-NeRF
definition: A learning-based 3D instance segmentation pipeline that takes a pre-trained NeRF as input and learns a 3D instance segmentation represented as an instance field component of the NeRF model.
summary: Instance-NeRF is a 3D instance segmentation pipeline that extends NeRF with an instance field to resolve multi-view inconsistent masks without relying on 3D bounding volume priors.
